# StreamX API

> Keyless, self-hostable movie & TV metadata API. Search titles, get details,
> posters/backdrops/logos and episode stills, critic scores (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes,
> Metacritic), cast & crew, person bios, similar titles, TV/anime data and
> where-to-watch streaming providers. No API key, ever.

Base URL: https://api.streamx.qzz.io (fallback https://streamx-api.pages.dev)

## Start here

- [Agent skill](./skill/SKILL.md): drop-in instructions any AI agent can follow.
- [Full reference](./skill/reference.md): every endpoint, param and response field.
- [MCP server](./mcp/README.md): expose the API to MCP-capable agents.
- [Self-hosting & forks](./docs/SELF-HOST.md): run your own copy anywhere.
- [README](./README.md): architecture, deploy buttons, comparison, roadmap.

## Quick usage

- Search: `GET /search?q=dune&type=movie` → `metas[].id`
- Details: `GET /meta/movie/tt0133093`
- Scores: `GET /scores/movie/tt0133093`
- Streaming: `GET /streaming/movie/tt0133093?country=US`
- Credits: `GET /credits/movie/tt0133093`
- Person: `GET /person/nm0000206`
- Similar: `GET /similar/movie/tt0133093`
- Trending: `GET /trending/movie`
- Posters: `https://api.streamx.qzz.io/img/poster/medium/tt0133093/img`
- Status: `GET /health`

## Notes

- All routes are `GET`/`HEAD`; `OPTIONS` → `204`; CORS `*`.
- `:type` = `movie` | `series`; ids are IMDb `tt…`; person ids are `nm…` or `Q…`.
- Upstream enrichment is fail-soft: optional fields may be `null`.
